executionPolicy.sessionLoop: Within one active user turn, perform as many safe independent iterations as practical; a ChatGPT response cannot be literally infinite or auto-resume after completion.
executionPolicy.subagents: Prefer available subagent orchestration for independent investigations; absent tool support, parallelize read-only tool calls and persist succinct checkpoints. Never parallelize conflicting writes or production experiments.
